text:
{
  "schema_version": "1.1",
  "characters": [
    {
      "character_id": "char_rhea",
      "name": "Rhea",
      "intro": {
        "chapter": 1,
        "scene": 1
      },
      "role": "protagonist"
    }
  ],
  "chapters": [
    {
      "chapter_id": 1,
      "title": "The Fine Print of Dying",
      "goal": "Establish Rhea's death, her arrival in the Ledger's frontier tutorial, and her first survival exploit using system wording.",
      "chapter_role": "hook",
      "stakes_shift": "From mundane death to surviving a predatory magical onboarding process.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "",
        "to_next": "Rhea must secure basic resources now that she has bypassed the initial death-trap."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 4,
        "tempo": "rush",
        "expected_scene_count": 6
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "The Bureaucracy of the Afterlife",
          "intent": "Establish Rhea's death and her immediate, disorienting arrival in the Ledger's frontier tutorial zone, highlighting the hostile UI.",
          "section_role": "setup",
          "target_scene_count": 2,
          "status": "locked",
          "end_condition": "Rhea successfully parses her first System notification and avoids immediate environmental death.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Rhea wakes up mid-freefall after a fatal car crash, crashing into a jagged, ash-covered wasteland. She experiences the immediate shock of her new reality as a glowing blue System notification blocks her vision, demanding she acknowledge her Indenture Status.",
              "type": "action",
              "outcome": "Rhea survives the initial impact with 1 HP due to a tutorial grace period, but is pinned under debris with a ticking UI prompt.",
              "characters": [
                "char_rhea"
              ],
              "introduces": [
                "char_rhea"
              ],
              "location_start_label": "Ashen Freefall Zone",
              "location_end_label": "Obsidian Impact Crater",
              "location_start": "Mid-air above a jagged, ash-covered wasteland.",
              "location_end": "At the bottom of a smoking crater made of shattered obsidian.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "detained",
              "transition_in_text": "Rhea transitions from the crunch of a steering column to the rushing wind of a terminal velocity drop over an alien landscape.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "shattered windshield glass",
                "rushing sulfur wind",
                "glowing blue text box"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Coughing up ash, Rhea stares at the blinking red timer on the indenture prompt as the obsidian shards shift around her trapped leg.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "blinking red timer",
                "shifting obsidian shards",
                "trapped left leg"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "1:2"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 2,
              "summary": "Pinned and bleeding, Rhea struggles to read the fine print of the System notification while the environment begins to deal passive heat damage. She manages to dismiss the prompt without accepting the default terms, freeing her vision just in time to roll away from a collapsing rock pillar.",
              "type": "progression",
              "outcome": "Rhea dismisses the indenture prompt, halting the passive environmental damage and freeing herself from the debris.",
              "characters": [
                "char_rhea"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:1",
              "location_start_label": "Obsidian Impact Crater",
              "location_end_label": "Crater Ridge",
              "location_start": "At the bottom of a smoking crater made of shattered obsidian.",
              "location_end": "The jagged upper lip of the impact crater.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Rhea scrapes her fingernails against the glassy rock, trying to leverage her weight off her trapped leg while the UI timer ticks down.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "glassy rock surface",
                "ticking UI timer",
                "bloody fingernails"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Dragging her battered leg over the crater's lip, Rhea collapses onto the cooler ash, the immediate threat of incineration replaced by the vast, empty expanse of the tutorial zone.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "crater lip",
                "cooling ash bed",
                "empty tutorial expanse"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "1:3",
              "end_condition_echo": "Rhea successfully parses her first System notification and avoids immediate environmental death."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Starter Pack Trap",
          "intent": "Reveal that the tutorial's 'helpful' starter gear is actually a predatory debt trap designed to enslave new arrivals.",
          "section_role": "complication",
          "target_scene_count": 2,
          "status": "locked",
          "end_condition": "Rhea identifies the hidden interest rate on the starter gear and explicitly refuses the standard acceptance prompt.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Rhea explores the Crater Ridge and finds a glowing 'Starter Cache' pedestal. Approaching it triggers an enthusiastic but legally dubious System onboarding package offering basic survival gear, but she notices a suspicious asterisk next to the 'Accept' button.",
              "type": "progression",
              "outcome": "Rhea triggers the Starter Cache prompt but halts before accepting, spotting the hidden terms indicator.",
              "characters": [
                "char_rhea"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:2",
              "location_start_label": "Crater Ridge",
              "location_end_label": "Starter Cache Pedestal",
              "location_start": "The jagged upper lip of the impact crater.",
              "location_end": "Next to a glowing stone pedestal on the ridge.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Limping along the cooling ash bed of the crater's edge, Rhea spots a perfectly square, glowing stone pedestal jutting from the wasteland.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "cooling ash bed",
                "glowing stone pedestal",
                "crater's edge"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Rhea hovers her trembling finger over the glowing blue 'Accept' rune, her eyes narrowing at the tiny, pulsing asterisk tucked into the corner of the holographic parchment.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "glowing blue Accept rune",
                "pulsing asterisk",
                "holographic parchment"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "1:4"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "summary": "Instead of clicking accept, Rhea manually expands the sub-menus of the System prompt. She uncovers a compounding interest rate payable in maximum HP and forced labor, prompting her to explicitly reject the terms and lock the cache.",
              "type": "progression",
              "outcome": "Rhea rejects the starter gear, locking the cache but avoiding the predatory debt trap.",
              "characters": [
                "char_rhea"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:3",
              "location_start_label": "Starter Cache Pedestal",
              "location_end_label": "Starter Cache Pedestal",
              "location_start": "Next to a glowing stone pedestal on the ridge.",
              "location_end": "Next to a glowing stone pedestal on the ridge.",
              "handoff_mode": "offscreen_processing",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Rhea taps the tiny asterisk instead of the main button, causing the holographic parchment to unroll into a dense wall of microscopic legal text.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "tiny asterisk",
                "holographic parchment",
                "microscopic legal text"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "With a sharp swipe of her hand, Rhea hits the hidden 'Decline' option, plunging the pedestal into darkness and leaving her alone with the howling wind.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "hidden Decline option",
                "darkened pedestal",
                "howling wind"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "1:5",
              "end_condition_echo": "Rhea identifies the hidden interest rate on the starter gear and explicitly refuses the standard acceptance prompt."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "Exploiting the Fine Print",
          "intent": "Rhea finds a loophole in the System's wording to secure basic gear without triggering the debt mechanics.",
          "section_role": "resolution",
          "target_scene_count": 2,
          "status": "draftable",
          "end_condition": "Rhea equips her first exploited item and receives a non-standard System confirmation of survival.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 5,
              "summary": "Rhea examines the darkened pedestal and the surrounding debris. She realizes that while the 'Starter Cache' is locked, the physical pedestal itself is made of System-generated materials. She uses a sharp piece of obsidian from the crater to chip away at the pedestal's base, exploiting a physics loophole where 'vandalism' isn't taxed or bound by the contract she rejected.",
              "type": "progression",
              "outcome": "Rhea successfully chips off a chunk of the pedestal, obtaining a raw, unbranded System material without triggering a contract.",
              "characters": [
                "char_rhea"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:4",
              "location_start_label": "Starter Cache Pedestal",
              "location_end_label": "Starter Cache Pedestal",
              "location_start": "Next to a darkened stone pedestal on the ridge.",
              "location_end": "Next to a damaged stone pedestal on the ridge.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Rhea stares at the darkened pedestal, the howling wind biting through her thin clothes, before her eyes drop to the sharp obsidian shards scattered around its base.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "darkened pedestal",
                "howling wind",
                "sharp obsidian shards"
              ],
              "transition_out_text": "Wiping sweat from her brow, Rhea pries a jagged chunk of glowing masonry loose from the pedestal's base, grinning as the System fails to issue a penalty.",
              "transition_out_anchors": [
                "jagged chunk of glowing masonry",
                "pedestal's base",
                "sweat-slicked brow"
              ],
              "hands_off_to": "1:6"
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "Rhea uses her bloody hands and the obsidian shard to fashion the masonry chunk into a crude, heavy bludgeon. Because she crafted it from environmental debris rather than accepting it through a UI prompt, the System is forced to recognize it as a 'Discovered' item rather than 'Leased'. She equips it, triggering a rare, glitchy System notification acknowledging her survival outside the intended parameters.",
              "type": "progression",
              "outcome": "Rhea equips her first exploited item and receives a non-standard System confirmation of survival.",
              "characters": [
                "char_rhea"
              ],
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:5",
              "location_start_label": "Starter Cache Pedestal",
              "location_end_label": "Crater Ridge",
              "location_start": "Next to a damaged stone pedestal on the ridge.",
              "location_end": "Walking along the jagged upper lip of the impact crater.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "transition_in_text": "Sitting cross-legged in the ash, Rhea scrapes the obsidian shard against the glowing masonry, grinding down the rough edges to form a makeshift handle.",
              "transition_in_anchors": [
                "ash-covered ground",
                "obsidian shard",
                "glowing masonry"
              ],
              "end_condition_echo": "Rhea equips her first exploited item and receives a non-standard System confirmation of survival."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
